summary: Final confirmation of THE Room at current head (1430d42) against w19 (89168b6). The score holds at 8.5 and nothing in THE Room regressed. git diff 89168b6..HEAD shows no change to src/09c_room.js, src/03_tex.js, tex/ or the room SEATMAT keys (09_seats.js changed only pyShell/pyArm/pyArmPad). Every room-only calibration region is identical to 1 L: q06 door L167, q06 near shell L64, q06 cabinet ash L149, q09 privacy wall L56, q09 ash L172, q09 pillow L90, q08 header band L105, q10 shell L82, q10 cap L116->114, q07 cabinet ash L158. Pixel changes (11-29 % of each frame) sit in the window and sidewall belt and the far bar, which belong to lighting and monuments. One lighting side-effect lands on a room part. In q07 the window-side shell post next to the 11A monitor fell from L103 to L75 (#5d6274 -> #454854), while c_27316 has the same post at L114 (#6b6e7c). That moves it away from the photo, but it is lighting, so it is noted and not scored. The w19 lows are all still open and unchanged: kick 0.08 against ~0.10-0.14 m, no silver rail over the kick, cap rails with no highlight, header band ~10 % dark, ash pinstripe, soft goods. No w18/w19 high or medium issue has regressed. Product read: clearly the same product with minor material and lighting differences.
